Following their victory over Adelaide United in the semi-finals, Sydney will next play Perth Glory to secure a back-to-back win in the league.
"This is a fantastic occasion for Australian women's football as we return to our highest debut level for our grand final on free-to-air TV," FFA chairman Christopher Zeidler said.
"We saw in last year's successful broadcast of the W-League final how enthusiastic audiences nationwide were to tune in and we hope to continue this growth and excitement as we aim to unify our fans behind the W-League - Australia's premier football competition for women since 2008.”
